exposure: previous lower segment Cesarean section (LSCS) deliveries
cohort: The study included 60 patients who underwent peripartum hysterectomy out of 11,440 deliveries in one year at a hospital in Rawalpindi.
finding: The incidence of peripartum hysterectomy was 5.2 per 1000 deliveries, with 88% of cases attributed to morbidly adherent placenta (MAP).
mod_finding: All patients who underwent peripartum hysterectomy due to morbidly adherent placenta (MAP) had a history of previous LSCS, with a significant proportion having multiple prior LSCS.
